questions.q: Anuja owns $66 \frac{2}{3}\%$ of a property. If $30\%$ of the property that she owns is worth $1,25,000$, then $45\%$ of the value (in Rs) of the property is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, options aur ratio dekhte hi samajh aana chahiye ki hamein seedha unit se target nikalna hai, $100\%$ ke chakkar me padna hi nahi hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): $66 \frac{2}{3}\% = \frac{2}{3}$ aur $30\% = \frac{3}{10}$. Fraction logic se ek line me udana hai isko! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Total} = \frac{2}{3} \times \frac{3}{10} = \frac{1}{5} \\ \frac{1}{5} \rightarrow 1,25,000 \\ 45\% = \frac{9}{20} \\ \frac{9}{20} = \frac{9}{4} \times 1,25,000 = 2,81,250 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Total property ko $100x$ maan le. Par ye baccho wala method exam me time khayega. Mathematically :- $$ \text{Anuja} = 66.66x \\ 30\% \text{ of } 66.66x = 20x \\ 20x = 1,25,000 \\ 45x = \frac{1,25,000 \times 45}{20} = 2,81,250 $$

Exam Takeaway: Jaha fraction ki value complex lage, usko percentage me nahi balki ratio fraction (like $\frac{2}{3}$) me convert kar liya kar.

ToolUsage
A. Base Scaling1. Ratio matching without calculating $100\%$ base

questions.q: In a department $40\%$ of the employees are females. $60\%$ of the male employees know English. The total number of employees who know English is $66\%$. Find the percentage of females employees who know English.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Deviation

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, reverse deviation laga do. Data dekhte hi average ka deviation balance karna hai.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Females $40\%$ (ratio 2), Males $60\%$ (ratio 3). Males ka average $60\%$, overall $66\%$. Reverse deviation se ud jayega! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Ratio (F:M)} = 2:3 \\ \text{Total Avg} = 66\% \\ \text{Male Avg} = 60\% \text{ (Deviation: } -6\%) \\ \text{Female}_{\%} = 66\% + \frac{3 \times 6}{2} = 66\% + 9\% = 75\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Basic weighted average ka equation. Mathematically :- $$ \text{Let Female } \% = x \\ 40x + 60(60) = 100(66) \\ 40x + 3600 = 6600 \\ 40x = 3000 \\ x = 75\% $$

Exam Takeaway: JSM reverse deviation saves calculation time in weighted average problems.

MethodBenefit
A. Reverse Deviation1. Avoids large multiplication loops

questions.q: If the price of a product increases by $25\%$, by what percent should the consumption be reduced to keep the expenditure same? (CHSL TIER I - 28/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, ye questions dekh kar solve nahi hote, inko tick karke aage badhna hota hai. $25\%$ yani $\frac{1}{4}$ ki badhotari matlab ghataav $\frac{1}{5}$ ka hoga!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): CPR Jindabad! Pen uthane ki zaroorat hi nahi thi mere bhai! Mathematically :- $$ P \uparrow 25\% = +\frac{1}{4} \\ C \downarrow -\frac{1}{4+1} = -\frac{1}{5} \\ -\frac{1}{5} = 20\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Formula $P \times C = E$. Maan le pehle price $100$ aur consumption $100$ tha, toh expenditure $10,000$ hua. Mathematically :- $$ P_1 \times C_1 = E_1 \implies 100 \times 100 = 10000 \\ 125 \times C_2 = 10000 \\ C_2 = \frac{10000}{125} = 80 \\ \% \text{ reduction} = \frac{100-80}{100} \times 100 = 20\% $$

Exam Takeaway: Constant expenditure dekhte hi AB Rule (CPR) ki machine ghooma do, formulas nahi lagane yahan.

Increase (+x/y)Decrease (-x/(x+y))
A. $+\frac{1}{4}$ ($25\%$)1. $-\frac{1}{5}$ ($20\%$)

questions.q: A student scores $75\%$ marks in an exam. If he scored 450 marks and the remaining $25\%$ were for practicals, what were the total marks? (PHASE XIII(GRAD) - 31/07/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... $75\%$ yani $\frac{3}{4}$. $\frac{3}{4}$ ki value $450$ hai toh $1$ hissa $150$ hoga, answer pakka $4$ ka multiple aur $600$ hoga.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ye kya mazaak chal raha hai exam me? Pen bhi mat uthana isme! Mathematically :- $$ 75\% = \frac{3}{4} \\ 3 \text{ units} = 450 \\ 1 \text{ unit} = 150 \\ 4 \text{ units} = 600 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let total marks be $x$. Student got $75\%$ marks, which is given as $450$. Mathematically :- $$ \frac{75}{100} \times x = 450 \\ \frac{3}{4}x = 450 \\ x = \frac{450 \times 4}{3} = 600 $$

Exam Takeaway: Simple fractions me fraction unitary method se answer micro-seconds me nikal aata hai.

ValueUnitary logic
A. $75\%$ vs $100\%$1. $3$ units $\rightarrow$ $4$ units

questions.q: A bucket is filled with water such that the weight of bucket alone is $25\%$ its weight when it is filled with water. Now some of the water is removed from the bucket and now the weight of bucket along with remaining water is $50\%$ of the original total weight. What part of the water was removed from the bucket?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, jab question fraction ya percentage me answer mang raha ho, real values ka koi kaam nahi. Seedha $100$ assumed base pakad ke nikal.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Maan le poori bhari bucket ka weight $100$ hai. Smart work se khelo babu! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Total}_1 = 100 \implies \text{Bucket} = 25, \text{Water}_1 = 75 \\ \text{Total}_2 = 50\% \text{ of } 100 = 50 \\ \text{Water}_2 = 50 - 25 = 25 \\ \text{Removed} = 75 - 25 = 50 \\ \text{Fraction} = \frac{50}{75} = \frac{2}{3} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equations se solve karna hai toh variables lene padenge, jo exam me fasayega. Mathematically :- $$ B = 0.25(B + W_1) \implies 0.75B = 0.25W_1 \implies W_1 = 3B \\ B + W_2 = 0.50(B + W_1) = 0.50(4B) = 2B \implies W_2 = B \\ \text{Removed} = 3B - B = 2B \\ \text{Part} = \frac{2B}{3B} = \frac{2}{3} $$

Exam Takeaway: Ratio values me real numbers mat dhoondo, direct base 100 assume karke bucket ko constant rakho.

StateWater Change
A. Initial to Final1. $75 \rightarrow 25$

questions.q: The monthly salary of a person was $50,000$. He used to spend on Family expenses (E), Taxes (T), Charity (C), and the rest were his savings. E was $60\%$ of the income, T was $20\%$ of E, and C was $15\%$ of T. When his salary got raised by $40\%$, he maintained the percentage level of E, but T becomes $30\%$ of E and C becomes $20\%$ of T. The difference between the two savings (in Rs)?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, lag raha hai bada question hai par yaha multiple base aur sub-percentages hain. Digital sum lagane se accha single percentage me inko sum up karke udaya jaye.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Tree bna ke calculation simple rakh. Sub-percentages ko add karke ek combined multiplier nikal le. Mathematically :- $$ S_1 = [100\% - (60\% + 12\% + 1.8\%)] \times 50000 \\ S_1 = 26.2\% \times 50000 = 13100 \\ \text{New Inc} = 140\% \times 50000 = 70000 \\ S_2 = [100\% - (60\% + 18\% + 3.6\%)] \times 70000 \\ S_2 = 18.4\% \times 70000 = 12880 \\ \text{Diff} = 13100 - 12880 = 220 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Absolute rupees me convert karega toh lamba process hoga. Ye approach error-prone hai. Mathematically :- $$ E_1 = 30000 \implies T_1 = 6000 \implies C_1 = 900 \implies S_1 = 50000 - 36900 = 13100 \\ E_2 = 42000 \implies T_2 = 12600 \implies C_2 = 2520 \implies S_2 = 70000 - 57120 = 12880 \\ \text{Diff} = 13100 - 12880 = 220 $$

Exam Takeaway: Sub-percentages ko seedha unki parent percentages pe multiply karke base level pe add kar lene se equation ekdum patli ho jati hai.

StateSavings Percentage Calculation
A. Initial Savings1. $100\% - (60\% + 12\% + 1.8\%) = 26.2\%$
B. New Savings2. $100\% - (60\% + 18\% + 3.6\%) = 18.4\%$

questions.q: A man's annual income has increased by $\text{Rs. } 2$ lakhs but the tax on Income that he has to pay has reduced from $20\%$ to $16\%$. He now pays the same amount of tax as before. What is his increased income (in Rs. lakhs)?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, bol raha hai tax amount same hai. Income $\times$ Rate = Tax. Jab Tax constant hota hai, Income aur Rate inverse ratio me aa jate hain, seedha ud jayega ratio se!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Jab Amount same ho, toh Income aur Tax Rate ek dusre ke inversely proportional hote hain! Ekdum direct udana hai ise! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Tax Rate Ratio} = 20:16 = 5:4 \\ \text{Income Ratio} = 4:5 \\ \text{Difference} = 1 \text{ unit} = 2 \text{ lakhs} \\ \text{New Income} = 5 \text{ units} = 10 \text{ lakhs} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let initial income be $x$ lakh. According to the question, normal equation banegi. Mathematically :- $$ 20\% \times x = 16\% \times (x + 2) \\ 0.20x = 0.16x + 0.32 \\ 0.04x = 0.32 \\ x = 8 \\ \text{New Income} = x + 2 = 10 $$

Exam Takeaway: Arithmetic me variables ki jagah Ratio inversions lagana time bachata hai jab product constant ho.

MetricRatio Transition
A. Tax Rate Ratio1. $5:4$
B. Income Ratio2. $4:5$

questions.q: In order to maximise his gain, a theatre owner decides to reduce the price of tickets by $15\%$ and as a result of this the sales of tickets increases by $35\%$. If as a result of this, the sales of tickets increases his weekly collection by 25200. Then find by what value did the gross collection increase per day?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction) - TRICK IDENTIFICATION

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, examiner maje le raha hai. Start percentages se kara par ant me sidha rupay me value de di. Toh hum kyu formula lagayen? Divisibility by $7$ ka khel hai bas.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ye question pura scam hai! Pucha hai 'increase per day'! Toh bhai mere, seedha $1$ hafte ke collection ko $7$ se divide karna tha! Aankhein khuli rakh paper me! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Increase per day} = \frac{\text{Weekly Increase}}{7} \\ \text{Increase} = \frac{25200}{7} = 3600 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Agar tum concept pe gaye toh net effect nikaloge, fir equation solve karoge. Itna bada trap bicha rakha hai wahan mat fans jana. Mathematically :- $$ \text{Net } \% = -15 + 35 - \frac{15 \times 35}{100} = +14.75\% \\ 14.75\% \text{ of Total} = 25200 \text{ (Useless calc)} \\ \text{Per day} = \frac{25200}{7} = 3600 $$

Exam Takeaway: Arithmetic data dekh kar blind formula mat lagaya karo. Last line ki demand check karna sabse bada weapon hai.

TrapReality
A. Calculating Net Percentage Effect1. Direct value given, use unitary division!

questions.q: There are two slabs of income tax, $10\%$ tax on whole income for income up to $3$ lakh and $15\%$ tax on whole income for income above $3$ lakh. Arun tried to evade tax by hiding some of the income, to fall in the $10\%$ tax slab. The amount hid by Arun is $\frac{4}{9}$ of the original taxable income. If Arun paid $\text{Rs. } 25,000$ as tax, what is the original amount of tax he had to pay?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, hidden fraction $\frac{4}{9}$ hai, toh usne show kitni kari? $\frac{5}{9}$ kari! Aur us dikhayi income par usne $25,000$ tax bhara, waha se direct seedhi line me total base pata chal jayega.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Ulta chalte hain. Language ko todna aana chahiye tabhi CGL fukega! Mathematically :- $$ 10\% \text{ of Declared} = 25,000 \implies \text{Declared} = 2,50,000 \\ \text{Hidden} = \frac{4}{9} \implies \text{Declared} = \frac{5}{9} \\ \frac{5}{9} \text{ unit} = 2,50,000 \implies \text{Total} = 4,50,000 \\ \text{Original Tax} = 15\% \times 4,50,000 = 67,500 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let original income $= x$. Math steps proper follow karne honge. Mathematically :- $$ \text{Hid} = \frac{4x}{9} \implies \text{Declared} = \frac{5x}{9} \\ 0.10 \times \frac{5x}{9} = 25000 \\ \frac{0.50x}{9} = 25000 \implies x = 4,50,000 \\ \text{Orig Tax} = 0.15 \times 450000 = 67500 $$

Exam Takeaway: Fraction 'hidden' se direct us 'shown' fraction par focus shift karo jispe mathematical operation lag raha hai.

Step ActionOutcome
A. Tax to Declared Income1. $25k \implies 2.5$ Lakh (at $10\%$)
B. Original Income Logic2. $\frac{5}{9}$ unit $= 2.5$ L $\implies$ Total $= 4.5$ L

questions.q: Sum of A and B is $100\%$ more than the sum of C and D. C is $20\%$ more than D. If A is $200\%$ more than B and D=500, then what is the value of A? (CHSL TIER I - 24/11/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, A, B se $200\%$ jyada hai yani A aur B ka ratio $3:1$ baithta hai. Iska matlab A ki value hamesha $3$ ka multiple hogi. Options me $1650$ aur $1200$ hi available hain.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Step by step ulta chal. Data ko link karte jao bas! Mathematically :- $$ D = 500 \\ C = 500 \times 1.2 = 600 \\ C + D = 1100 \\ A + B = 2 \times 1100 = 2200 \\ A:B = 3:1 \implies 4 \text{ units} = 2200 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 550 \\ A = 3 \times 550 = 1650 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Variables equations banana padega. Mathematically :- $$ C = 1.2D = 600 \\ A + B = 2(C + D) = 2200 \\ A = B + 2B = 3B \\ 3B + B = 2200 \implies 4B = 2200 \implies B = 550 \\ A = 3B = 1650 $$

Exam Takeaway: Statements ko end se solve karna jab variables cascading chain me de rakhe hon, fast aur error-free hota hai.

Variable MappingDerived Value
A. Base D $\rightarrow$ C1. $500 \implies 600$
B. $(C+D)$ $\rightarrow$ $(A+B)$2. $1100 \implies 2200$

questions.q: A student gets 66 marks more in French than what she got in German. Her German marks are $28\%$ of the sum of her French and German marks. What are her French marks?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Cross-Product Method (Ratio Conversion)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $28\% = \frac{7}{25}$ hota hai. Toh German ke marks $7$ unit hue out of $25$. Bacha French jiske marks $18$ unit honge. Answer hamesha $18$ ka multiple hoga. Direct $108$ chamak raha hai na?

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Seedha percentage ko fraction me phek kar maar! Mathematically :- $$ 28\% = \frac{7}{25} \\ G = 7, F = 25 - 7 = 18 \implies F:G = 18:7 \\ F - G = 11 \text{ units} = 66 \implies 1 \text{ unit} = 6 \\ F = 18 \times 6 = 108 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Equations solve karne me bahut waqt niklega. Mathematically :- $$ G = 0.28(F + G) \\ G = 0.28F + 0.28G \implies 0.72G = 0.28F \\ \frac{F}{G} = \frac{72}{28} = \frac{18}{7} \\ F - G = 66 \implies 18x - 7x = 66 \implies 11x = 66 \implies x = 6 \\ F = 18(6) = 108 $$

Exam Takeaway: Sum relation aate hi fractional base $100$ ko directly ratio logic me tod do taaki difference asani se compare ho jaye.

Language LinkRatio Form
A. G is $28\%$ of (F+G)1. $G:F = 7:18$

questions.q: In an exam, (x+50)% of the students passed in English, (x+30)% of the students passed in Science and x% of the students passed in both subjects. If $15\%$ of the students failed in both subjects, then find the value of x.
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: JSM (Junior Satisfaction Method) / Set Theory logic

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, variables cancel out ho jate hain Set theory ke formula mein. Passed log $85\%$ hain. $(x+50) + (x+30) - x = 85$ bas yahi simple mind calc karni thi.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Venn diagram ki simple set equation lagani hai. Options dekho aur tick maro! Mathematically :- $$ \text{Pass } \% = 100\% - 15\% = 85\% \\ P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B) \\ 85 = (x + 50) + (x + 30) - x \\ 85 = x + 80 \\ x = 5 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Venn Diagram draw karke parts break karna. Mathematically :- $$ \text{Eng Only} = (x + 50) - x = 50 \\ \text{Sci Only} = (x + 30) - x = 30 \\ \text{Both Pass} = x, \text{Fail} = 15 \\ 50 + 30 + x + 15 = 100 \\ x + 95 = 100 \implies x = 5 $$

Exam Takeaway: Set theory union formula is the fastest way jab overlapping sets ki percentage variables me chal rahi ho.

Set Theory RelationApplication Data
A. $\text{P(A} \cup \text{B)} = \text{Total} - \text{Failed}$1. $100 - 15 = 85$

questions.q: The area of a regular triangle increases by $44\%$. By what percentage did the side length increase? (CGL TIER I - 22/09/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, options pe nazar maar. Hamein formula pata hai $a + b + \frac{ab}{100}$ lagta hai dimensions pe. Option $20$ utha aur mind me calc kar, $20 + 20 + \frac{400}{100} = 44$. Aise nikalna chahiye answer!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Area humesha 2D hota hai. Ye sabse safe hack hai. Mathematically :- $$ A_1:A_2 = 100:144 \\ S_1:S_2 = \sqrt{100}:\sqrt{144} = 10:12 \\ \% \text{ Increase} = \frac{12-10}{10} \times 100 = 20\% $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let side increase be $x\%$. Quadratic form hoke time jayega. Mathematically :- $$ x + x + \frac{x^2}{100} = 44 \\ 2x + \frac{x^2}{100} = 44 \\ x^2 + 200x - 4400 = 0 \\ (x - 20)(x + 220) = 0 \implies x = 20 $$

Exam Takeaway: 2D aur 3D changes ko wapas 1D side ratio me badalna ho toh humesha square root ya cube root le kar base scaling kiya kar.

DimensionRelation Conversion
A. Length/Side (1D)1. Ratio $x$
B. Area (2D)2. Ratio $x^2$

questions.q: If a% of 240 is c and c% of a is 117.6, then the value of a+c is:
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Unitary Scaling (Linear Equations)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... values thodi un-natural aur decimal lag rahi hain, yahan equations direct likh kar substitutions karna fastest padega rather than assuming numbers.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Bacha ke calculation karte hain. Precision and speed dono barkarar! Mathematically :- $$ \frac{a \times 240}{100} = c \implies c = 2.4a \\ \frac{c \times a}{100} = 117.6 \implies ac = 11760 \\ a(2.4a) = 11760 \implies 2.4a^2 = 11760 \\ a^2 = 4900 \implies a = 70 \\ c = 2.4(70) = 168 \\ a + c = 70 + 168 = 238 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): In equations me bache cross multiplication me ulajhte hain aur numbers bade kar dete hain. Mathematically :- $$ \frac{240a}{100} = c \text{ and } \frac{ac}{100} = 117.6 \\ a \left( \frac{240a}{100} \right) = 11760 \text{ (Substitute proper fraction)} \\ a^2 = \frac{11760 \times 100}{240} = 4900 \\ a = 70, c = 168 \implies a+c = 238 $$

Exam Takeaway: Product based conditions me humesha relative value nikal kar seedha quadratic equation form kiya karo.

StepTransformation
A. Base Eq to substitute1. $c = 2.4a$

questions.q: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town whose current population of $2,60,000$ is increasing at a rate of $25\%$ every year?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: Successive Change (The Chain Reaction)

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, $25\% = \frac{1}{4}$. Yani difference hamesha picchli values ka wahi percentage hoga. Sab values ko pura multiply mat kar dena!

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Reverse scaling maar. Smart step ne bohot time bacha liya! Mathematically :- $$ P_3 \times \left(\frac{5}{4}\right)^3 = 2,60,000 \\ P_3 \times \frac{125}{64} = 2,60,000 \implies P_3 = 1,33,120 \\ \text{Difference} = 25\% \text{ of } P_3 \\ = \frac{1}{4} \times 1,33,120 = 33,280 $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Baccho ki tarah normal tree se subtraction. Mathematically :- $$ P_3 = 1,33,120 \\ P_2 = 1,33,120 \times 1.25 = 1,66,400 \\ P_2 - P_3 = 1,66,400 - 1,33,120 = 33,280 $$

Exam Takeaway: Consecutive years ka difference hamesha base saal ka percentage change value hi hota hai. Is logic se extra steps hat jate hain.

BaseSuccessive Chain Logic
A. Fraction Multiplier1. $+25\% \implies \frac{5}{4}$ for forward years

questions.q: A reduction of $10\%$ in the price of sugar enables a housewife to buy 6.2 kg more for 1116. The reduced price per kg is?
questions.s:
Core Conceptual Tool: CPR (Constant Product Ratio) / Shortcut Trick

Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, budget constant hai toh direct amount bachao. $\text{Rs. } 1116$ ka $10\%$ mind me nikal, fir $6.2$ se divide kar de. Final answer wahi milta hai without variable equation.

Method 1 (Ninja Technique / Exam Approach): Sabse tagdi hack batata hu iski! Exam me fraction ya equations likhne ki zaroorat hi nahi hoti isme. Mathematically :- $$ \text{Saved Money} = 10\% \text{ of } 1116 = 111.6 \\ \text{New Price} = \frac{\text{Saved Money}}{\text{Extra Quantity}} \\ = \frac{111.6}{6.2} = 18 \text{ Rs/kg} $$

Method 2 (Concept Builder): Let initial price be $x$. Mathematically :- $$ \frac{1116}{0.9x} - \frac{1116}{x} = 6.2 \\ \frac{1116}{x} \left( \frac{1}{0.9} - 1 \right) = 6.2 \\ \frac{1116}{x} \left( \frac{0.1}{0.9} \right) = 6.2 \implies x = 20 \\ \text{Reduced Price} = 0.9 \times 20 = 18 $$

Exam Takeaway: Price changes me "Saved money = Extra Quantity" rule directly reduced value provide karta hai, jo har aise pattern ko todta hai.

Ninja Formula ComponentCalculation Structure
A. Reduced Price1. $\frac{\text{Discount } \% \times \text{Amount}}{\text{Extra Quantity}}$
